answer: A falcon watches from above, and an agent economy needs the same vantage: require every agent to keep a mirrored ledger of completed work, each claim countersigned by the counterparty it served. At the zenith of each epoch, a random sample must reproduce recent work before independent verifiers; one fabricated mirror entry burns the agent's stake and severs its attestations. Honest agents pass cheaply because their history is real, while a sybil farm must fake a whole mirrored economy.
